_help: Rig settings per character for the walk cycles (python3 -m pixelforge sheets <package> --only <id>). Multipliers scale the default motion. arms: anatomical side -> full (upper arm + forearm swing) | upper (stump: only the upper arm swings) | none (no arm: nothing moves there).

obese_male._note: the belly outline confuses the arm detection: arms stay still

obese_female._note: the dress hem hides the legs: only the lower legs and feet swing

missing_left_arm._note: the zombie's RIGHT arm is cut off (screen-left in the S view)

missing_right_forearm._note: both forearms are cut off, only short stumps remain
